exam.title: MongoDB Associate Data Modeler
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is published, but MongoDB positions the exam for experienced users familiar with JSON, MongoDB Query API operations and aggregations, data modeling, and simplicity-versus-performance tradeoffs. Practice a complete evidence-led requirements, entity, relationship, workload, model, index, monitoring, and compatible-evolution cycle.

review.notes: All eight September 2 weighted domains are mapped through an evidence-led requirements, entity, relationship, workload, candidate-model, technical-constraint, index, monitoring and compatible-evolution cycle. Three scenarios, eight authorized labs and 40 original checks are included. The current 75-question/110-minute contract renders, while the enrolled detailed guide could not be deterministically re-audited on September 7; that blocker, the dated weights, stale 70/105 route, and August path alignment are explicit. An older MongoDB technical article adds workload-led model and memory/index practice without being treated as current scope. No recalled/live item, dump or copied course content is used.

public_objective_groups.title: Requirements Gathering
objectives: Identify application operations and performance priorities that drive the model.
Identify the business, data-source, governance, and technical information required before modeling.

public_objective_groups.title: Entities
objectives: Identify persisted entities, attributes, types, and domain groupings.
Identify domain ownership and where duplication and synchronization may be required.

public_objective_groups.title: Relationships
objectives: Identify relationships, cardinality, skew, strong entities, weak entities, and identifying keys.

public_objective_groups.title: Workload/Usage
objectives: Describe reads, writes, updates, deletes, aggregations, frequency, priority, latency, volume, and growth.
Use workload evidence to identify operations that require model optimization.

public_objective_groups.title: Data Model Design
objectives: Select embedding or referencing for entity relationships and access patterns.
Apply appropriate schema design patterns and identify anti-patterns.
Evaluate duplication, consistency, atomicity, document growth, and application complexity tradeoffs.

public_objective_groups.title: Modeling for Technical Requirements
objectives: Adapt the model for validation, data types, lifecycle, transactions, analytics, sharding, and other stated technical constraints.

public_objective_groups.title: Indexing
objectives: Select indexes from query predicates, sort, range, projection, selectivity, and workload needs.
Interpret explain evidence and balance read benefit against storage and write cost.

public_objective_groups.title: Monitoring and Evolving Data Models
objectives: Use workload and performance evidence to detect model problems.
Plan compatible schema evolution, migrations, versioning, validation changes, and rollback.
